description: This script is a performance testing script for Git commands, particularly focusing on 'git for-each-ref' and related commands such as creating refs, tags, and testing different options and configurations.

methods.name: test_for_each_ref
methods.description: Runs performance tests on 'git for-each-ref' with various arguments and options, repeated 'test_iteration_count' times.

methods.name: run_tests
methods.description: Executes a series of 'test_for_each_ref' commands with different arguments and configurations, including packed refs and tags.
